name: Swiss Poster
tagline: xiaoma's swiss reel theme: ink ground, bone type, red / yellow / Klein blue swaps on the beat, Archivo Black wide, HUD brackets.

motion.direction: Swiss reel. A strict grid: Archivo Black wide uppercase, mono HUD labels, `focusRing` corner brackets and a timecode; full-screen colour swaps on the downbeat between ink `stage`, red `ter`, yellow `gold` and Klein blue `goldd` (use `bleedPlate` for the swap); one scene per bar (≈1.9 s at 128 BPM), every cut on a downbeat, entrances 4–6 frames under a mask, stagger 0.04–0.06 s, out_expo. Numbers as `counter`s in mono; lists as `chips` on the grid. No bloom, no fades, no rounded cards; "2 frames off and it falls apart".
